shared_elements: an animal/creature rendered in modelled relief
single dominant creature filling the field
justification: Both depict a single animal-like creature modelled in the round/relief with an eye, brow and muzzle articulated, which is about as generic a correspondence as sculpture allows. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a frontal head with a broad band of incised crosshatched lattice over the crown and no body shown, while B is a whole quadruped in strict profile, couched with folded legs and haunch, set within an oval field and with no geometric ornament at all.
